description: Codex agentic routing configuration — selects the model for OpenAI-Responses-style requests emitted by the Codex CLI agent, based on the request class (main turn, auxiliary title generation, context compaction) and on the work mode of the turn (planning, implementing, testing, reviewing, debugging).

codex_modes.name: plan
codex_modes.description: The agent plans before touching any file: breaking work down into steps, defining architecture, roadmap, scope and strategy. Selected for Codex Plan Mode and requests that explicitly ask for an approach, design or implementation plan without making changes.
examples: Zaplanuj migrację tej usługi do nowego schematu bazy danych.
Jak najlepiej podzielić ten moduł na mniejsze części?
Przygotuj plan refaktoryzacji pakietu routing.

Outline the steps needed to migrate the config to JSON.
Najpierw przygotuj plan rozwiązania tego problemu, bez wprowadzania zmian.
Przeanalizuj repozytorium i zaproponuj kolejność prac.
Rozpisz strategię implementacji tego feature'a krok po kroku.
Zaproponuj architekturę dla obsługi wielu providerów.
Przygotuj plan zmian w API i wszystkich zależnych modułach.

codex_modes.name: implement
codex_modes.description: The agent writes or edits code: implementing features, creating or modifying modules, wiring components, adding functionality and changing application behaviour. This is the default main-turn mode and fallback when no more specific mode is detected.

codex_modes.name: test
codex_modes.description: The agent writes, repairs or runs automated tests: unit and integration suites, coverage, fixtures and CI test commands. Explicit testing intent takes precedence over generic implementation wording.
examples: Przygotuj testy jednostkowe dla modułu wandb.

codex_modes.name: git_review
codex_modes.description: The agent works with Git and repository history rather than primarily changing application code: inspecting diffs, branches, commits and history, comparing branches, reviewing pull or merge requests, resolving Git conflicts and performing Git operations such as commit, push, pull, rebase, merge, cherry-pick, checkout and worktree operations.

codex_modes.name: review
codex_modes.description: The agent reviews existing code without primarily owning the change: inspecting code or a diff, finding potential problems, edge cases, maintainability issues and suggesting improvements without being explicitly asked to diagnose a concrete failure.

codex_modes.name: debug
codex_modes.description: The agent diagnoses and repairs broken behaviour: concrete failures, stack traces, exceptions, crashes, hangs and regressions. It is distinguished from general review by an explicit failure symptom or request to find the root cause and fix it.

codex_modes.name: compaction
codex_modes.description: Context compaction request emitted by the Codex CLI when the conversation window has to be summarized so it fits the model context. Routed by request class only and takes precedence over every other signal.
